in_marathi.name: Devisingh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Gods
in_marathi.long_meaning: Devisingh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Devi Singh means God of Gods. This name is derived from the Sanskrit name ‘Deva’ which means God and ‘Singh’ which means Lion. The name Devisingh is given to a boy who is believed to possess the qualities of a powerful and fearless lion. It is a popular name in the Hindu community and is often used as a title for Gods and leaders.
